marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The 9 intense experiences : an action plan to change your life forever

"Positive transformation visionary Brian Vaszily takes you on a unique voyage of epiphanies that provide you greater clarity, focus, energy and joy. The 9 Intense Experiences is a highly prescriptive book packed with practical, enjoyable and unique steps you can take right away to change your life in powerful ways: Delve into the nine areas of the world’s most transformative experiences that have largely been forgotten in today’s high-stress world Irresistible and fun, the experiences and their exercises and action steps don’t require a ton of your time or energy Builds on Brian Vaszily’s bestselling audio programs, seminars and teachings from his popular website Boost your energy, self-awareness, self-confidence, creativity, and focus while eliminating stress, anxiety, and depression"--
